paragraphs: Coupang is a technology and Fortune 150 company listed on the New York Stock Exchange that provides retail, restaurant delivery, video streaming, and fintech services to customers under brands that include Coupang, Eats, Play, Rocket Now, and Farfetch. We serve millions of customers in over 190 countries and territories around the world.

We have organized our operations into two segments: Product Commerce and Developing Offerings. These segments reflect the way we evaluate our business performance and manage operations. Information on our segments is included in Part II, Item 7 "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations — Overview — Segment Information." Financial information for our segments is included in Note 3 — "Segment Reporting" to the consolidated financial statements included in Part II, Item 8 of this Form 10-K.

We are committed to building a one-of-a-kind service for our customers designed to provide them with the best selection, savings, and service. Our approach focuses on controlling the entire end-to-end experience – from technology and automation to fulfillment and logistics – so we can continually raise the bar for what customers expect.

The technology, infrastructure, and operational excellence we have built allow us to invest in customer experiences and new, adjacent services. Capabilities originally developed to deliver general merchandise at speed have evolved to support fresh grocery, food delivery, digital entertainment, payments, and other services – all designed to make our customers' lives easier.
Across our markets, customers benefit from one or more of our core experiences built around speed, convenience, and reliability including:
•Fast, reliable delivery experience, ranging from next-day, dawn, and even same-day delivery, with order cutoffs as late as midnight;
•Broad selection, spanning daily essentials, general merchandise, fresh groceries, luxury, and specialized niche categories;
•Frictionless returns, designed to be as simple and customer friendly as ordering; and
•Digital services, such as streaming entertainment and secure payments.
Through our WOW membership offerings, customers receive additional value – such as delivery benefits and service perks – further reinforcing a seamless, high-value experience.

Whether through local commerce, international selection, food delivery, or global marketplaces like Farfetch – which connects customers with some of the world's leading luxury brands – we combine technology, fulfillment, logistics, and customer obsession to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

Small and medium-sized enterprises ("SMEs") on Coupang form an essential part of our business, and we strive to make it easy for SMEs to reach customers all over the world with our comprehensive end-to-end support. We have invested billions of dollars to expand artificial intelligence ("AI") technologies and other innovations, helping to accelerate the growth of hundreds of thousands of SMEs around the world. In the United States, for example, sellers ship their products to one of Coupang's U.S. facilities, and Coupang's world-class fulfillment and logistics teams receive, store, pick, pack, and ship those products directly to customers. Coupang's online retail services are helping U.S. brands drive billions of dollars in international sales every year. And in the Republic of Korea ("Korea"), more than 75% of our SME sellers are based outside Seoul, supporting regional businesses and more balanced economic development. We have reimagined traditional online commerce to strengthen local businesses. By streamlining the entire supply chain through direct sourcing and mobile fulfillment sites, Coupang enables faster delivery of high-volume, locally sourced products. This helps small businesses reach more customers, grow sustainably, and thrive in an increasingly connected marketplace.

At Coupang, we continue to develop new ways for SMEs to unlock growth through offerings such as Coupang's Private Label Brand, which develops and markets high-quality products under our private label at affordable prices. As more SMEs partner with Coupang on private label products, more jobs are created. We also launched Rocket Overseas to customers in Taiwan, empowering SME partners to unlock growth by connecting with customers in other countries, bringing savings and convenience to both customers and merchants.

We offer merchants of all sizes around the world the opportunity to sell through Coupang and provide effective solutions to improve customer experience and enhance demand generation. Our fulfillment and logistics by Coupang offering in Korea ("FLC") empowers merchants by offering them access to our industry-leading fulfillment, logistics, and customer network services.

headings: We may experience significant fluctuations in our results of operations.

Our limited operating history and evolving business make it difficult to evaluate our future prospects, including future revenues, growth rate, and margins as well as the risks and challenges we may encounter.
If we fail to effectively manage our growth, our business, financial condition, and results of operations could be harmed.
If we do not successfully operate and manage the expansion of our fulfillment and logistics infrastructure, our business, financial condition, and results of operations could be materially harmed.
We operate in a highly competitive industry and we may be unsuccessful in competing against current and future competitors, which could have a negative impact on the success of our business.
Our expansion into new geographies and new product and service offerings and our substantial increase in the number of offerings may expose us to new and increased challenges and risks.
paragraphs: Investing in our Class A common stock involves a high degree of risk. You should consider and read carefully all of the risks, uncertainties, events, and contingencies described below, as well as other information included in this Form 10-K, including the sections titled "Special Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements," "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations," and our consolidated financial statements and related notes appearing elsewhere in this Form 10-K, before making an investment decision. The risks, uncertainties, events, and contingencies described below may not be the only ones we face. Our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects, as well as the price of our Class A common stock could also be affected by additional factors that apply to all companies operating globally. The occurrence of any of the following, or additional, risks, uncertainties, events, and contingencies not presently known to us, or that we currently believe to be immaterial, or that apply to all companies operating globally could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects, as well as the price of our Class A common stock which would cause you to lose all or part of your investment. Some of the risks, uncertainties, events, and contingencies discussed below may have occurred in the past, but the descriptions below are not representations as to whether or not the risks, uncertainties, events, or contingencies have occurred in the past and instead reflect our beliefs and opinions as to the risks, uncertainties, events, and contingencies that could materially and adversely affect us in the future.

Our business faces significant risks, uncertainties, events, and contingencies. The risk factors described below are only a summary of the principal risk factors associated with investing in our Class A common stock. These risks are more fully described in this "Risk Factors" section, including the following:

•our results of operations may fluctuate significantly, which makes our future results of operations and prospects difficult to predict and could cause our results of operations to fall below expectations;

•our business is rapidly evolving, and we plan to continue to forgo short-term financial performance for long-term growth, which makes it difficult to evaluate our future prospects and predict our future results of operations, including our revenue growth rate;
•we may be unable to effectively manage the continued growth of our workforce, operations, and infrastructure, including the development, acquisition, and management of new business initiatives;
•we have had a history of net losses, and we may not maintain profitability in future periods;

Coupang is a technology and Fortune 150 company listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CPNG) that provides retail, restaurant delivery, video streaming, and fintech services to customers around the world under brands that include Coupang, Eats, Play, Rocket Now, and Farfetch. Headquartered in the United States, Coupang has operations and support services in geographies including Korea, Taiwan, Singapore, China, India, Japan, and Europe. Coupang's mission is to revolutionize the everyday lives of its customers and create a world where people wonder, "How did I ever live without Coupang?"

We believe that we are a preeminent retail destination because of our broad selection, low prices, and exceptional delivery and customer experience across our owned inventory selection as well as products offered by third-party merchants. Our unique end-to-end integrated fulfillment, logistics, and technology network enables Rocket Delivery, which provides free, next-day delivery for orders placed anytime of the day, even seconds before midnight—across millions of products in Korea. Our structural advantages from complete end-to-end integration, investments in technology, and scale economies generate higher efficiencies that allow us to pass savings to customers in the form of lower prices. The capabilities we have built provide us with opportunities to expand into other offerings and geographies.
Data Incident and Customer Compensation Program

In November 2025, Coupang became aware of a data incident involving unauthorized access to customer accounts (the "Incident"). For additional information, see Part I, Item 1A. "Risk Factors," Part I, Item 1C. "Cybersecurity," and Note 14 — "Commitments and Contingencies" to the consolidated financial statements included in Part II, Item 8. "Financial Statements and Supplementary Data" of this Form 10-K.

In December 2025, Coupang Corp., our Korean subsidiary, announced a customer compensation program to issue approximately $1.2 billion worth of vouchers, beginning in January 2026, to customers who were notified of the Incident at the end of November 2025 that may be applied towards future Coupang purchases (the "Customer Compensation Program"). These vouchers will be reflected as reductions to the selling price and revenue recognized on each corresponding transaction as they are redeemed. The Customer Compensation Program may reduce net revenues growth and profitability primarily in the first quarter of 2026.

We believe that the Incident has increased and may further increase the Korean government's focus on our business and could result in additional expenses, including from remediation, inquiries, enforcement actions, and litigation.

In January 2024 we acquired the business and assets of Farfetch Holdings plc ("Farfetch"), a leading global marketplace for the luxury fashion industry. Throughout 2024 and 2025, we undertook restructuring actions to reduce headcount and exit leases and licensing agreements associated with Farfetch. See Note 16 — "Business Combinations - Farfetch" to the consolidated financial statements included in Part II, Item 8 of this Form 10-K.

In June 2021, a fire extensively damaged our Deokpyeong fulfillment center ("FC Fire") resulting in a loss of the inventory, building, equipment, and other assets at the site. We are insured on property losses from the FC Fire, and while the insurer continues assessment of the total potential loss coverage on the claim, during the fourth quarter of 2024 we agreed to a settlement on a portion of the claim and deemed the recovery of insurance proceeds under the policy as probable. We recognized an insurance gain of $175 million in the fourth quarter of 2024, which included $116 million for the inventory loss included in "Cost of sales" and $59 million for property and equipment losses, included in "Operating, general and administrative". Whether and to what extent additional insurance recoveries will be received is currently unknown.

Our segments reflect the way we evaluate our business performance and manage operations. See Note 3 — "Segment Reporting" to the consolidated financial statements included in Part II, Item 8 of this Form 10-K.

Product Commerce primarily includes our core Korean retail (owned inventory) and marketplace offerings (third-party merchants, including SMEs) and Rocket Fresh, our fresh grocery offering, as well as advertising products associated with these offerings. Revenues from Product Commerce are derived primarily from online product sales of owned inventory to customers in Korea, commissions and logistics and fulfillment fees from merchants that sell products through our mobile application and website, and from our Korean retail WOW membership program.

Developing Offerings includes more nascent offerings and services, including Eats (our restaurant ordering and delivery service), Play (our online content streaming service), fintech, our retail operations in Taiwan, as well as advertising products associated with these offerings. Developing Offerings also includes Farfetch (our global luxury fashion marketplace). Revenues from Developing Offerings are primarily generated from Farfetch, Eats, and retail operations in Taiwan.
Coupang 是一家科技公司，為《財富》150 強企業，於紐約證券交易所上市，透過包含 Coupang、Eats、Play、Rocket Now 與 Farfetch 等品牌，為客戶提供零售、餐廳外送、視訊串流及金融科技服務。我們服務全球超過 190 個國家與地區的數百萬客戶。
我們已將營運分為兩個應報告分部：產品通義與開發服務。這些分部反映我們評估營運績效與管理營運的方式。有關分部資訊，請參閱本 Form 10-K 第二部分，第 7 項「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析 — 總覽 — 分部資訊」。有關分部之財務資訊，請參閱本 Form 10-K 第二部分，第 8 項所附合併財務報表之附註 3 — 「分部報導」。
我們致力於為客戶打造獨一無二的服務，以提供最佳的選擇、節省與服務。我們的策略著重於掌控從科技與自動化至履行與物流的整個端到端體驗，使我們能持續提升客戶所期待的標準。
我們所建構的科技、基礎建設與營運卓越能力，使我們能投資於客戶體驗與新興、相關服務。原本用於快速配送一般商品的技術能力，已進化為支持新鮮蔬果、食品外送、數位娛樂、支付及其他服務 — 所有這些服務皆旨在簡化客戶的生活。
在各個市場中，客戶可受益於一個或多個我們核心體驗，這些體驗圍繞著速度、便利性與可靠性，包括：
•快速且可靠的配送體驗，從隔日、清晨甚至同日配送，訂單截止時間可晚至午夜；
•廣泛的選擇，涵蓋日常用品、一般商品、新鮮蔬果、豪華商品及專業小眾類別；
•無摩擦退貨，設計為與下單一樣簡單且親近客戶；
•數位服務，例如串流娛樂及安全付款。
透過我們的 WOW 會員方案，客戶可獲得額外價值 – 例如配送好處與服務優惠 – 進一步強化無縫且高價值的體驗。
無論是透過本地商業、國際選項、食物配送，或全球市集如 Farfetch – 連接客戶與世界頂級奢侈品牌 – 我們結合科技、倉儲、物流與客戶至上的理念，提供卓越的客戶體驗。

Coupang 上的中小企業 ("SMEs") 是我們業務的重要組成部分，我們致力於讓 SMEs 輕鬆達成全球客戶，並提供完整的端到端支援。我們已投資數十億美元擴展人工智慧 ("AI") 技術及其他創新，協助全球數十萬家 SMEs 加速成長。例如，在美國，販售者會將其產品運送到 Coupang 的美國倉庫，而 Coupang 的世界級倉儲與物流團隊會接收、儲存、揀選、包裝並直接將這些產品運送到客戶手中。Coupang 的線上零售服務每年協助美國品牌實現數十億美元的國際銷售。而在韓國 ("Korea")，我們超過 75% 的 SME 賣家設立於首爾以外地區，支持區域性企業與更平衡的經濟發展。我們重新定義傳統的線上商業模式，強化本地企業。透過直接採購與行動倉儲站點簡化整個供應鏈，Coupang 有助於更快地配送高需求、本地來源的產品。這有助於小企業接觸更多客戶、實現可持續成長，並在日益連接的市場中茁壯成長。

在 Coupang，我們持續開發新的方式，讓 SMEs 透過如 Coupang 私標品牌 ("Private Label Brand") 的方案來實現成長，該方案在我們的私標下開發與行銷高品質產品，價格親民。隨著越來越多 SMEs 與 Coupang 合作推出私標產品，將創造更多工作機會。我們也於臺灣推出 Rocket Overseas，協助 SME 合作夥伴透過與其他國家的客戶連結來實現成長，為客戶與販售者帶來節省與便利。
我們為全球各規模的販售者提供透過 Coup,ang 售賣的機會，並提供有效的解決方案以改善客戶體驗並提升需求產生。我們在韓國 ("FLC") 提供的 Coupang 倉儲與物流服務 ("Coupang Fulfillment and Logistics")，賦予販售者使用我們行業領先的倉儲、物流與客戶網路服務的機會。

Coupang為一家科技公司，為《財富》全球150大企業，於紐約證券交易所（NYSE: CPNG）上市，提供零售、餐飲外送、視訊串流及金融科技服務，服務全球客戶，品牌包括Coupang、Eats、Play、Rocket Now及Farfetch。總部設於美國，Coupang在韓國、臺灣、新加坡、中國、印度、日本及歐洲等地有營運與支援服務。Coup,ang的使命是革新客戶的日常生活，創造一個世界，人們會問：『我怎麼可能沒有Coupang呢？』

我們認為，我們是優秀的零售目的地，因為我們有廣泛的選擇、低價格，以及在自有存貨選項及第三方商家提供的產品上，卓越的配送與客戶體驗。我們獨特的端到端整合履行、物流與科技網路，使Rocket Delivery成為可能，提供全天候的免費隔日配送服務，即使在午夜前幾秒鐘下單也能實現，服務韓國數百萬種商品。我們從完整的端到端整合、科技投資與規模經濟所產生的結構優勢，產生更高的效率，使我們能以更低的價格將節省下來的費用轉讓給客戶。我們所建立的能力，使我們有機會拓展至其他產品與地區。
資料事件與客戶賠償計畫
2025年11月，Coupang得知有涉及客戶帳戶未經授權存取的資料事件（「事件」）。如需更多資訊，請參閱本表10-K第一部分，第1A項「風險因素」，第一部分，第1C項「網路安全」，以及第二部分，第8項「財務報表與補充資料」所附合併財務報表的附註14 — 「承諾與或有事項」。
2025年12月，我們的韓國子公司Coupang Corp.宣佈了一項客戶賠償計畫，自2026年1月起，發放價值約12億美元的禮券，給在2025年11月底得知事件的客戶，這些禮券可應用於未來的Coupang購買（「客戶賠償計畫」）。這些禮券將反映為各筆交易的銷售價格減讓與認列收入的減少，當它們被兌換時。客戶賠償計畫可能主要在2026年第一季減少淨收入成長與獲利能力。
我們認為此次事件已使韓國政府對本公司業務的關注度提高，且可能進一步提高，並可能導致額外費用，包括從整治、詢問、執法行動及訴訟產生的費用。
2024年1月，本公司取得Farfetch Holdings plc（"Farfetch"）的業務與資產，Farfetch為全球首屈一指的奢侈時尚產業市場平台。在2024年及2025年期間，本公司進行結構重整行動，以減少人力及退出與Farfetch相關的租賃與授權協議。詳情請參閱本Form 10-K第二部分，第8項「綜合財務報表」所附的附註16 — "企業合併 - Farfetch"。

2021年6月，一場火災嚴重損壞了本公司位於德克平的物流中心（"FC Fire"），導致該場地的存貨、建築物、設備及其他資產損失。本公司針對FC Fire的財產損失投保，雖然保險公司仍在評估該申報的總潛在損失賠償範圍，但在2024年第四季，本公司同意就部分申報進行和解，並認為根據保險條款的賠償金額為可實現。本公司於2024年第四季認列保險獲利1.75億美元，其中包括1.16億美元用以彌補存貨損失（包含於"銷售成本"），以及5,900萬美元用以彌補財產及設備損失（包含於"營運、一般及行政"）。

是否以及在多大範圍內會收到額外的保險賠償，目前尚無法確定。
本公司各應報告分部反映本公司評估業務績效及管理營運的方式。詳情請參閱本Form 10-K第二部分，第8項「綜合財務報表」所附的附註3 — "分部報告"。

產品通 commerce 主要包括本公司核心韓國零售業務（自有存貨）及市場平台業務（第三方商家，包括中小企業）以及Rocket Fresh，本公司鮮食業務，以及與這些業務相關的廣告產品。產品通 commerce 的收入主要來自於本公司向韓國消費者銷售自有存貨的線上產品銷售，以及來自於透過本公司行動應用程式及網站銷售產品的商家所支付的佣金及物流與履行費用，以及來自本公司韓國零售 WOW 會員制度的收入。
發展中的業務包括更多新興的業務與服務，包括 Eats（本公司餐廳訂餐與外送服務）、Play（本公司線上內容串流服務）、金融科技、本公司在臺灣的零售業務，以及與這些業務相關的廣告產品。發展中的業務也包括 Farfetch（本公司全球奢侈時尚市場平台）。發展中的業務的收入主要來自於 Farfetch、Eats 以及本公司在臺灣的零售業務。

headings: 我們可能面臨營業成果的重大波動。
我們有限的營運歷史與持續進化的業務，使我們難以評估未來的前景，包括未來的營收、成長率與毛利率，以及我們可能遇到的風險與挑戰。
若我們無法有效管理成長，將可能對我們的業務、財務狀況與營業成果造成損害。
若我們未能成功運作並管理履行與物流基礎設施的擴張，將可能對我們的業務、財務狀況與營業成果造成重大損害。
我們所處的產業為高度競爭，我們可能無法成功與現有及未來的競爭對手競爭，這將對我們業務的成功產生負面影響。
我們擴張至新地理區域與新產品與服務，以及我們大幅增加的產品與服務種類，可能使我們面臨新的與增加的挑戰與風險。
paragraphs: 投資本公司的A類普通股涉及高度風險。您應仔細考慮並閱讀下列所描述的所有風險、不確定性、事件及潛在問題，以及本Form 10-K所包含的其他資訊，包括標題為『特別提醒有關向前看陳述』、『管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之討論與分析』，以及我們合併財務報表及相關附註，於此Form 10-K其他處所出現之內容，再做投資決策。下列所描述的風險、不確定性、事件及潛在問題，可能並非我們所面臨的唯一風險。我們的業務、財務狀況、營運結果與前景，以及本公司A類普通股的價格，也可能受到適用於全球所有公司的其他因素影響。上述任何一項，或其它未被我們目前所知悉，或目前認為不重要，或適用於全球所有公司的風險、不確定性、事件及潛在問題發生，可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運結果與前景，以及本公司A類普通股的價格造成重大且不利的影響，導致您損失全部或部分投資。下列所討論的一些風險、不確定性、事件及潛在問題，可能在過去已經發生，但下列描述並非表示這些風險、不確定性、事件或潛在問題是否在過去已經發生，而是反映我們對未來可能對我們造成重大且不利影響的風險、不確定性、事件及潛在問題的信念與意見。
我們的業務面臨重大風險、不確定性、事件及潛在問題。下列所描述的風險因素僅為投資本公司A類普通股所涉及的主要風險因素之摘要。這些風險在本『風險因素』節中更為詳細說明，包括以下內容：
•我們的營運結果可能大幅波動，使我們未來的營運結果與前景難以預測，並可能導致我們的營運結果低於預期；
•我們的業務處於快速演進階段，我們計畫持續為長期成長而放棄短期財務表現，這使評估我們的未來前景與預測未來營運結果變得困難，包括我們的營收成長率；
•我們可能無法有效管理我們員工數量、營運及基礎建設的持續成長，包括新業務計畫的開發、收購與管理；
•我們過去有淨虧損的歷史，我們可能無法在未來期間維持獲利能力；
